Cleaned RHC Benchmark Cohort

rhc_sample.Rd

The cleaned Right Heart Catheterization (RHC) cohort from the SUPPORT study, as produced by prepare_rhc_data. RHC was associated with harm in the original analysis (Connors et al. 1996); the data are bundled so the validation vignette and tests run offline and deterministically.

Usage

rhc_sample

Format

A list with two elements:

data

A data frame with 5735 rows and 63 columns. swang1 is the binary exposure (1 = RHC); dth30 is 30-day mortality and los is length of stay in days.

covariates

A character vector of the 50 confounder column names used by the adjustment methods.

Details

The raw file's quirks are resolved here: the write.csv row-names column is dropped, the cat2 category "None" (stored as the literal text "NA") is restored, remaining literal "NA" strings become real missing values, the swang1 exposure and dth30/death outcomes are recoded 0/1, and los is derived from the admission and discharge dates. The heavy-missingness columns adld3p and urin1 are excluded from the covariate vector.

Examples

data(rhc_sample)
str(rhc_sample$data)
